example.hakka: 天光恅著寒,啉燒茶較好。
example.romanization: Thiên-kông lâu-chho̍k hòn, lîm sêu-chhà kha-hó.
example.english: It's cold this morning, it's better to drink hot tea.

note: 燒 (sêu) means "hot/burning" in Hakka, distinct from Mandarin's 熱 (rè) — pairing it with 茶 is a very natural everyday collocation, often contrasted with 冷茶 (lâng-chhà, "cold tea").
